verificationEnvironment.evidenceMethod: Read the inline ytInitialPlayerResponse object from each rendered watch page; record playabilityStatus and captionTracks. Browser transcript export was additionally checked only where explicitly recorded.

requirements: spoken video with no caption tracks
non-verbal video with no caption tracks
exclusions: downloaded media or stored transcript bodies

samples.title: Me at the zoo
samples.author: jawed
samples.selectionReason: Very short, old and widely referenced public video. It provides a cheap happy-path check without ASR or a large transcript.
samples.testExpectation: A source should deterministically select and return the authored English track; it should not label this track as ASR.

samples.title: Do schools kill creativity? | Sir Ken Robinson | TED
samples.author: TED
samples.selectionReason: Old official TED upload with an unusually rich caption set. English exists twice, once authored and once ASR, which exposes track-selection bugs.
samples.testExpectation: Methods must expose or consistently apply a language/track policy. In the signed-out zh-CN browser, the panel exporter selected authored zh-CN rather than English.

samples.title: The Future of Human Intelligence: Education, AI, & Creativity | Sir Ken Robinson (Full Keynote)
samples.author: Sir Ken Robinson
samples.selectionReason: Long-form ASR-only video. It separates track discovery from transcript retrieval and exercises payload size and timeout behavior.

browserTranscriptExport.message: No transcript is available for this YouTube video

directTimedtextNavigation.caveat: This is one signed-out browser attempt using the baseUrl advertised by the same page; it does not prove that every token-aware extractor will fail.

samples.testExpectation: A passing track-list check is insufficient. Record track discovery and text retrieval separately, with a bounded timeout and an explicit failure reason.

samples.title: 留十八分鐘給自己：蔣勳 (Chiang Hsun) at TEDxTaipei 2012
samples.author: TEDxTaipei
samples.selectionReason: Stable older Chinese-language talk with a small, unambiguous pair of authored tracks. It tests language ordering without a huge multilingual set.
samples.testExpectation: A source-language policy should select zh-TW rather than blindly taking the first advertised track, which is English in the observed response.

samples.title: Hope invites | Tsutomu Uematsu | TEDxSapporo
samples.author: TEDx Talks
samples.selectionReason: Popular older Japanese-language TEDx talk with several human-authored translations. It tests source-language inference when Japanese is not the first track.
samples.testExpectation: The extractor should not treat the first track, French, as the source language. Language selection must be explicit or observable in the result.

samples.title: 停止內耗，從相信自己開始 To End Inner Conflict, Start by Believing in Yourself｜周慕姿 | Mu-Tzu Chou | TEDxTaipei
samples.author: TEDx Talks
samples.selectionReason: Public spoken talk where the rendered player response currently advertises no caption tracks. This is a stronger negative case than a silent film.

verification.driftWarning: Captions may be added later; re-read captionTracks before each comparison run.

samples.testExpectation: Return a clean no-caption result without fabricating text, retry storms, or silently changing to a third-party paid service.

samples.title: Big Buck Bunny 60fps 4K - Official Blender Foundation Short Film
samples.author: Blender
samples.selectionReason: Official Blender upload with no spoken dialogue and no caption tracks. It is a stable expected-negative control.
samples.testExpectation: Return a clean no-caption result quickly. This control distinguishes a normal negative from a parser or network failure.
